title: docs(agents): say what the required lint job verifies about the SDUI manifest
body:
Fixes #18818

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— `AGENTS.md` 里 `check:react-declaration-parity` 那一段。原话说 repo-root 的
`sdui.manifest.json`「held honest in the required lint job by `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`」,
读上去像是那个必过 job 把这个门禁的四条腿都验了。改成说清必过 lint job 真正验的是哪几项(离线记录检查:
存在性、形状、sha256 对记录、记录里的 pin 对 `.objectui-sha`),以及版本-对-pin 那条腿只在手上有 objectui
checkout 的地方跑、在 lint 里按设计打印 `NOT CHECKED`。`check:react-declaration-parity --strict` 每个 PR
都跑这半句是真的,原样留着。一段文档,⛔ 不动 workflow、不动生产者字节。

**为什么改** —— 这是「声明了但没人兑现」落在给 agent 读的约定上。卡面原来的诉求是把 check 4 变成会红的
门禁(选项 A),但席位实测 A 已死:它要挂靠的 console-build 作业自称 ADVISORY,红在那里挡不住合并,等于
再加一层幽灵门禁。裁决 5773785605 判 B —— 顾问式行为保留,把 declaration 修对。本 PR 只执行 B。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险极低:纯文档,一次 revert 回去。代价是行数棘轮 1116/1116、headroom 0,
这一段为了容纳新增的事实,删掉了两处**可证的重复**,两处都还有幸存载体(见下面 Line budget)。

**席位意见** —— 技能席 1(`session_01Wnstp2kTth7sGXfr8fXypc`)已按 GitHub 与拉取的 head `90fe409e4` 复核:一段十一行改十一行,+9/−9,只动裁决 B 第 1 项那一句;新句子的两半本席在 worktree 上亲自复现(无 objectui checkout 时脚本 exit 0 并打印 NOT CHECKED,`--require-objectui` 时 exit 1;`lint.yml` :892 不带该 flag,:6671 才是 `--strict` 的那条门禁)。为付两行:删掉的两句在树内各有存活载体(`check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts:18`;`AGENTS.md:158` 的完整生成命令),ratchet 1116/1116、最宽表行 768 未动。第 2 项的 23 处 grep 逐条处置,更宽一圈的四处载体都已是窄写法;第 3、4 项照办。复核记录 PASS 5774909150(席内 fable),`--pair` 0,ACCEPT 5774910610 在卡上。⚠️ 请您合并时看一眼:裁决第 1 项举的两个「版本-对-pin 腿会跑的地方」(pin bump 与 advisory console-build)实测都不调用该脚本,`--require-objectui` 在树上零调用者,所以落地句只写了裁决的核心、没抄那段枚举——本席认同。裁决 B 的追认仍挂在 summon #27 的账本里,您一句话可推翻。建议合并。

**你要做的** —— 读一遍改后的段落,确认它描述的保证就是你希望必过 lint job 提供的那个;然后合并
(`AGENTS.md` 是 Tier H,人合)。如果你反而希望 check 4 真的成为必过门禁,裁决里写明那是另一张卡、由你
点名开启 —— 本 PR 不预支那个决定。

Clause-②: no

---

## What changed

One paragraph in `AGENTS.md`, line-neutral. Premise re-measured on `origin/main` `4fba5036f`
before editing: the clause is still there, verbatim as the ruling quotes it, but it spans
**:764-766**, not :763-765 (the ruling and the dispatch are one line off on each end; same
sentence, same bytes).

### Before — `AGENTS.md` :762-766 at `4fba5036f`

```text
don't read it as proof anything renders. Its right-hand side is the **tracked repo-root
`sdui.manifest.json`**, written by `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` beside
`scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` and held honest in the required lint job by
`scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` — so `lint.yml` runs this gate `--strict` against it on
every PR.
```

### After — `AGENTS.md` :761-766

```text
just don't read it as proof anything renders. Its right-hand side is the **tracked
repo-root `sdui.manifest.json`** and its record `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, which
the required lint job's `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` checks OFFLINE only — existence,
shape, sha256 vs the record, record pin vs `.objectui-sha`; its version-vs-pin leg runs
only where an objectui checkout is in hand, so lint prints `NOT CHECKED` by design.
`lint.yml` runs THIS gate `--strict` against it on every PR;
```

`this gate` became `THIS gate` because the corrected sentence now sits between the two, and the
pronoun would otherwise read as `check-sdui-manifest.mjs`. The `--strict`-on-every-PR half is
unchanged in substance: it is true (`lint.yml` :6671 runs it with `MANIFEST="$PWD/sdui.manifest.json"`).

## The evidence, run in this worktree

Both legs of the corrected sentence reproduce directly. This container happens to have a
`../objectui` sibling, so the plain run resolves check 4 — which is itself the measurement that
the leg is checkout-gated rather than job-gated:

```text
$ node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs                     # a checkout IS in hand
EXIT=0
✓ check-sdui-manifest: sdui.manifest.json is present, intact (sha256 49211fee7792…, 57 components)
  and recorded at the live objectui pin 87af769e9a3e….
  @object-ui 17.6.0 is the version objectui 87af769e9a3e… declares in packages/core/package.json
  (read from /home/user/objectui).

$ OBJECTUI_ROOT=/nonexistent-objectui node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs   # the lint-job condition
EXIT=0
✓ check-sdui-manifest: sdui.manifest.json is present, intact … and recorded at the live objectui pin …
  NOT CHECKED — objectuiPackagesVersion "17.6.0" was not compared with what the pin declares:
  no objectui checkout at /nonexistent-objectui (no .git there).

$ OBJECTUI_ROOT=/nonexistent-objectui node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs --require-objectui
EXIT=1
✗ check-sdui-manifest: --require-objectui was passed and check 4 could not run …
```

The first two prove the sentence as written; the third is the flag the card wanted wired, shown
working and deliberately left unwired (ruling item 3).

## Sibling over-claims — every grep hit disposed of (ruling item 2)

`grep -nE 'check-sdui-manifest|NOT CHECKED|require-objectui' AGENTS.md scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs
.github/workflows/lint.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml` at `4fba5036f` returns **23 hits**, matching the
dispatch's count. Note `ci.yml` contributes **zero** of them.

| hits | where | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `AGENTS.md` :765 | **the over-claim — rewritten here** |
| 1 | `AGENTS.md` :159 | TRUE, untouched. It names check 3 (staleness): the pin moves, the record trails, lint reds. That leg is offline, so the claim holds. |
| 19 | `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` :5 :8 :9 :10 :50 :77 :331 :342 :380 :477 :482 :580 :584 :595 :604 :608 :614 :627 :629 | TRUE, untouched. The header states the honest shape at :73-80 ("Check 4's oracle is an objectui CHECKOUT, which a required lint job does not have and must not clone"). :627-:629 is the `NOT CHECKED` print the ruling ring-fenced. |
| 1 | `lint.yml` :892 | The `run:` line itself, not a claim. Untouched. |
| 1 | `lint.yml` :6665 | TRUE, untouched. "held fresh by the check-sdui-manifest step in the lint job" — freshness IS check 3, which does run there. It makes no claim about check 4. |

`lint.yml` :881-:889 (the truthful "Offline record checks only" comment) and the script's :627-:629 are
untouched, per ruling item 2.

I also swept **outside** the named grep radius, since item 2 says "any sibling sentence on the tree".
`git grep -n 'check-sdui-manifest'` repo-wide finds four more prose carriers, and all four are already
narrow — none needed a change:

- `docs/releases-maintenance.md` :128-133 enumerates exactly the offline legs and never mentions the version leg.
- `docs/releases-maintenance.md` :281 and `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` :711-:713, :743 all name check 3 explicitly ("reds while the record's pin trails `.objectui-sha`").
- `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts` :389, :394 says "holds artefact, record and pin together" — checks 1/2/3, and its `--strict`-every-PR sentence is about the parity ratchet.

## A measured divergence from the ruling's illustration — please read this one

Ruling item 1 names two places the version-vs-pin leg runs: "the pin bump … and the advisory
console-build job". I measured both before writing them down, and **neither invokes the gate**:

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` `console-pin` (`Console Pin Gate`) does shallow-clone objectui at the pin,
  but its steps are `bash scripts/build-console.sh`, `pnpm check:console-sha` and
  `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp`. It never runs `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` — that is why
  the grep above returns zero `ci.yml` hits.
- `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` does not invoke the gate either. It *tells the operator* the required lint
  job will red the bump PR until the manifest is regenerated — which is check 3, offline, and true.
- `--require-objectui` has **zero callers** anywhere in the tree: `git grep -- '--require-objectui'`
  returns 8 hits, all inside its own script (argv parse, refusal text, self-test).

So the honest statement is the narrower one the ruling's own core sentence asks for, and it is what
landed: the leg "runs only where an objectui checkout is in hand". Writing "and the advisory
console-build job" would have replaced one over-claim with another, which is the failure this card
exists to correct (Prime Directive #10). The ruling's core obligation is executed as written; only its
parenthetical enumeration is left out, on measurement.

## Line budget — ratchet 1116/1116, headroom 0

`AGENTS.md` is 1116 lines before and 1116 after; the paragraph stays 11 physical lines and its wrap
width does not grow (max 90 characters after, against 91 before). Verdict line from the gate on the
final head:

```text
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: AGENTS.md is 1116 lines (ceiling 1116; headroom 0).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: AGENTS.md: widest table row is 768 bytes (pin 768; headroom 0).
```

The corrected clause is longer than the one it replaces, and an 11-line paragraph at this wrap width
holds no slack for it. Per the ratchet's own rule, the only legal currency is deleting content, so two
**provable duplicates** paid for it — each with a named surviving carrier, so nothing left the tree:

1. `A prop both sides declare and no renderer reads is, to this gate, perfect agreement.` — the middle
   term of a three-way restatement. The paragraph's own bold opening still states the claim ("compares
   two DECLARATIONS, not a declaration against an implementation") and the next sentence still states
   the rule ("don't read it as proof anything renders"). Surviving carriers, both fuller:
   `docs/adr/0082-react-component-contract-governance.md` :129 and the gate's own header at
   `packages/spec/scripts/check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts` :17-20. This is exactly the division
   of labour `AGENTS.md` :18-19 declares: "the rule is stated once here and the script's own header is
   the authority on detail".
2. `written by node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs beside` — the generator name. Surviving carrier
   `AGENTS.md` :158-159, which carries the **full** invocation including the `--objectui-version` flag
   this copy never had. The survivor is strictly the more complete of the two.

Nothing was re-wrapped to buy a line, and the ceiling is untouched.

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` reading is in the report comment on #18818.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`, measured rather than assumed. 83 tracked `package.json` files, 70 with a `files[]`
array: **zero** entries name `AGENTS`, and **zero** escape their package directory (no `..`, no
leading `/`), so no tarball can reach a repo-root file. Positive control that the reader works:
`packages/spec` `files[]` reads back as `dist, json-schema, liveness, prompts, llms.txt, README.md,
src/**/*.zod.ts, CHANGELOG.md, api-surface, spec-changes.json`. Nothing here publishes.

## Acceptance notes

- The ruling's item-1 enumeration of where check 4 runs does not match the tree; measured above and
  left out of the prose rather than copied in. Not filed as a card — it is a wording detail inside a
  ruling, and this PR is its correction of record.
- `--require-objectui` exists, is self-tested, and has zero callers. That is the card's own subject
  (#18611 / #18818) and the ruling decided to leave it so; noted here, not acted on.
- `docs/releases-maintenance.md` :128 says "Two required lint steps read that tracked pair on every
  PR" — true as written (both steps do run per PR), and its own bullet immediately narrows the first
  step to the offline legs. Left untouched.

## Landing

`AGENTS.md` is a governed surface, **Tier H** — the maintainer merges. Opened as draft and left draft;
no auto-merge, no queue, no ready flip from this seat.
